_not: SÜRÜM NOTLARI (Ömer 2026-10-11): ana menüde sağ alttaki sürüm yazısına dokununca açılan Patch Notes penceresi (src/ui/patch-notes.ts). En yeni sürüm en üstte. Her sürüm: version, date (YYYY-MM-DD) ve ya 'items' (düz satırlar) ya da 'groups' ({ heading: New | Changes | Fixes, items }). Satırlar KISA, oyuncuya yönelik, sade İngilizce; dosya adı / iç terim yok. Sürüm kuralı (Ömer 2026-10-11): küçük güncelleme (tek skill ayarı, hata düzeltme, arayüz değişikliği, performans) ALT sürüm alır: 0.6.11 -> 0.6.11.1 -> 0.6.11.2 (package.json 0.6.11 kalır); büyük güncelleme üçüncü sayıyı artırır (0.6.12, package.json da); ara sürümleri (0.7.0) Ömer söyler; yalnızca taslak (mockup) paylaşımı sürüm ve not ALMAZ. Ekranda görünen sürüm EN ÜSTTEKİ girdidir (vite.config.ts > __DISPLAY_VERSION__, src/ui/display-version.ts). tests/patch-notes.test.ts: en üstteki sürüm = package.json sürümü ya da onun '.N' alt sürümü.

groups.heading: New
items: Rounds now bring extra reinforcement waves instead of splitting the enemy group; the leader comes in the last round
New Valor screen with slowly burning braziers
Stat tooltips show the primary stat bonus as one short line under the name
New Victory and Defeat crests

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign and Endless rebalanced for reinforcement waves; heroes level a bit slower again
Fainter footpath roads on the campaign map; Quick Battle hero hover shows a short description
Better phone layout: larger buttons, readable save slots

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Deleting a save no longer reloads the whole Load Game page

groups.heading: Changes
items: Quick Battle: calmer stat and skill bar for the selected hero

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The merchant's welcome card no longer slides off the left edge of the screen

groups.heading: New
items: Battles come in rounds: 2 from the Watchtower on (Castle Morvane 3), and in Endless from battle 6
Calmer campaign map: small names, details on hover, cleared stops fade, legend behind the ? button
New campaign save slots: three large cards

groups.heading: Changes
items: Retreating from a patrol now calls it off, but each hero loses up to 30% HP
DEFEATED marks appear as soon as the guards are beaten
Campaign enemies rebalanced for rounds; Dwarven Mine is a bit harder
Two-handed weapons are stronger, so Equip best picks them more often
New Peat Smoke effect; Glyph of Breaking now lies flat on the ground

groups.heading: New
items: New campaign stop: Cairn Hill, between Windy Moor and the Iron Pass fork
Event, treasure, rest and new companion windows got a new look; cleared guarded stops show a DEFEATED stamp
Hero cards show a portrait and a short description

groups.heading: Changes
items: Story stops on the map now wait for you to confirm on their card
Thane of the Deep is less tanky; Anti-Mage drains his MP-fed armor
Two-handed weapons drop more often in the campaign
Enemy skill effects are better sized, placed and timed; thrown skills fly to their target

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Phone: bigger touch targets, readable Gear, Formation and results screens, and many small panel fixes

groups.heading: New
items: Version 0.9: the new campaign (free roam, levels and stat points, Blacksmith), the redesigned Anti-Mage and the new screens

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Anti-Mage no longer turns away when hit; her daggers sit more naturally at rest

groups.heading: New
items: Free roam on the campaign map: walk back to cleared stops, patrols roam the roads
Stat points to spend on every level up, up to Level 30
Blacksmith in towns
Map stops get framed icons by type, with double roads

groups.heading: Changes
items: Fewer item drops, but elites drop Uncommon or better and bosses Rare or better
Resting no longer revives fallen heroes; the first rest is free, later ones cost gold
Medium: escorts on elite stops are tougher

groups.heading: New
items: Anti-Mage redesign: she now throws daggers from range, with new poses, portrait and skill motions
Formation window rebuilt: hero panel, reach hint on every cell, drag to swap
Merchant wares now use the Gear item plates with prices; item details on hover
New battle result screen with per-hero stats and a summary strip

groups.heading: Changes
items: Every enemy skill effect redrawn by hand (VFX test panel)
New class and skill icons for Hexer, Anti-Mage, Gambler, Cutthroat and summons
Endless toggle moved onto the Quick Battle card as a slide-out tab

groups.heading: New
items: Gear equipped items shown as plates with slot, main stat and affixes.
New skill and class icons for Paladin, Archer, Mage, Druid and Undead.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Hand-coded Halberd Chop and Wall of Pikes effects in the effect test are more realistic.
Loot item icons are square like the bag.
Stat and skill point rows swapped on the Sheet.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Stat tooltips follow the +/- buttons; skill plates keep their height during stat previews.

groups.heading: New
items: Battle bar redesigned: bigger hero block, skill plates with Passive and Ultimate ribbons.
Pinned unit card redesigned with effects, skills and passive.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Gear Sheet stats redesigned with full stat names.
Hand-coded Rend effect in the effect test is darker and more realistic.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Item tooltips no longer linger as a faint ghost.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Battle character card redesigned with level next to the name; passive section removed.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Skill tooltip icons in battle no longer show the button frame.

groups.heading: New
items: New tooltip style for stats, skills, heroes and map nodes.
Gear skills now show as plates with Passive and Ultimate ribbons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: New Rage and Cooldown icons.
Loot XP bars fill a bit slower.
Fallen heroes on the map show a short revive line.

groups.heading: New
items: Boss warning attacks are now marked Unblockable; Backstab too.
Shield block chance now shows on the battle unit card.
Loot screen shows each hero's XP bar filling up, with a Level Up glow; tap a hero to open their gear.
New Warrior skill and class icons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Fallen heroes can't equip items anywhere, but can spend stat points.
Victory banner text is shorter and fits its frame.
Softer item tooltip glow.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Long hero names no longer overlap text in the item tooltip.

groups.heading: New
items: Shields now give Block chance: a blocked physical hit deals no damage and no effects; new shield-only Block affix.
Fallen heroes show as fallen in Gear and their gear is locked.
Warrior idle and guard poses redrawn so the weapon no longer covers the face.
Hand-coded skill effects added to the in-battle effect test.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Item tooltip redesigned; affix tiers sorted high to low.
Skills block shown on both Hero and Sheet tabs.
Tapping a road starts the walk while the fight card opens; leaving a hero behind shows a fading card.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Floating stat text (+6) is now sharp.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Chests and simple events on the map open straight from the stop card.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Gear: skills get the full page width, tips are never cut off, and the bag is narrower.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The merchant's reroll button keeps its frame on hover.

groups.heading: New
items: Debug: VFX frame test in a real battle, an enemy casts on a training dummy.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Clicking inside the Loot screen no longer asks to leave items; Cancel returns to the loot.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Loot and Endless rewards show only the bag next to the spoils.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Skill columns sit in the same places for every hero; stat rows are tighter with + then -.

groups.heading: Changes
items: A hero with points to spend glows in the party list; tap to open their Sheet.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The Formation tip only lights Formation; the Gear glow stops once Gear is opened.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Battles play about 10% faster at the default speed; the Battle speed setting still reads 1x.

groups.heading: New
items: Debug: VFX frame test page compares enemy skill animations with extra in-between frames.

groups.heading: New
items: Map stops open a small card beside the stop with a line of lore, the foes and the action.

groups.heading: New
items: Keyboard: C opens the hero screen, F opens Formation.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Every stop type uses the new card: Enter town, Rest, Trade, Open, Continue or Fight.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Endless reward View bag uses the new Gear ledger.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Double-clicking a bag item at the merchant sells it again.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The stop card points at the right stop on very wide or tall windows.

groups.heading: New
items: Loot screen after each campaign battle: drag the spoils into the bag or onto a hero.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Merchant uses the new ledger with Buy & Sell and Buyback tabs; reroll is an icon.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Tapping a hero or Hero details opens that hero in the Gear screen; the old hero window is gone.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Level ups show a short banner and the Gear button glows instead of a popup.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Gear and Formation buttons sit at the bottom left on campaign screens.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Enemy skill effects are 20% smaller; area effects are centered; bolts burst on first contact.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The Warrior's one-handed axe and mace sit in his fist again.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Sheet stats line up in even columns; on big screens the Gear screen no longer fills the whole screen.

groups.heading: New
items: New Gear screen: one full-page ledger for every hero, with Hero and Sheet tabs and hero bookmarks on the left.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The close button now sits where Menu is; Menu comes back when the window closes.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Sheet tab shows HP and MP bars, stat rows with - and + buttons, and a skill tree page (coming soon).

groups.heading: Changes
items: Empty gear slots show drawn slot icons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Battles and the map use much less memory, and battles open faster.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Scrolling no longer sticks while an item tip is pinned.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Balance touch-up: Defender loses a little Strength and Armor, gains Luck.
Druid's Thorn Whip and Nature's Wrath hit 5% harder.
Paladin's Holy Strike and Radiance hit 3% harder; Judgment's fire burns a bit hotter.
Passive is now shown first next to a hero's skills.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Class balance pass: Cutthroat, Druid, Defender, Anti-Mage, Mage, Paladin and Warrior numbers adjusted.
Resurrection costs less mana. Whirlwind hits a bit harder.
Skeletons and Treants now grow with their summoner. Skeletons hit harder and act sooner.
Treant's Vine Snare now chains from enemy to enemy, losing 20% damage per jump.
Units no longer skip a turn when waiting gains nothing.
Enemy skill effects play faster, hit the right spot and stay behind units in front.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Stat + buttons no longer move when you click them.

groups.heading: New
items: Debug: Mob battle fills both sides with enemy mobs.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Enemy skill effects play faster, closer to hero skills.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Enemy skill effects play at a smoother speed: easy to see, no longer slow.
Character stats are grouped like in battle: HP and MP on top, then Base, Attack and Defense columns.

groups.heading: New
items: Formation hints: a warning mark shows when a unit can't reach the enemy from its cell.
Long-range units standing in front get a hint to move back. Nothing is blocked.

groups.heading: New
items: Skills now have a range: units must stand close enough to reach their target. Skill cards show Range N or Global.
Heroes and enemies now gain levels; spend 3 stat points per level in Gear > Character.
Weapons have base power and every class starts with its own. New two-handed Greataxe, Greatsword and War Maul.
Warrior's new ultimate Headsman's Blow spends all Rage on one execution strike; Whirlwind now heals.
Share your multiplayer lobby on WhatsApp or Discord.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The AI arranges formations by range, ultimates start with one extra turn of cooldown, and class balance is retuned.
Battles load much faster; Back, Menu and Fullscreen buttons are larger on desktop; the grave marker is clearer.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: No more black screen while a battle loads, and menu music no longer starts on the loading screen.

groups.heading: New
items: Every campaign enemy now has its own skill effects, and the Bridge Warden has new skill icons, effects and animations.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The High Priest of the Undying fight plays normal battle music again; only boss fights have boss music.

groups.heading: New
items: Every boss fight has its own fast-paced music, and Lord Morvane's speeds up with each phase.

groups.heading: Changes
items: All music is softer and varies as it plays.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The main menu music is softer and changes as it plays, so it no longer repeats the same loop.

groups.heading: New
items: Region III enemies (Ember Hierophant, Drake Priest, Lord Morvane) have their own art, skill icons and skill effects.

groups.heading: New
items: Sworn Guard, Ash Hound and Cinder Gatewarden have their own art.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign tutorial: open Formation before the Ravenwood battle; the button glows until you do.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The Valor window fits on short phone screens.

groups.heading: New
items: Morvane Halberdier has its own art, skill icons and skill effects.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Enemy skill effects in the campaign are bigger, slower and brighter, with a clear flash on impact.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Buttons no longer stop working after a new version is released while the game is open; the game reloads itself.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Ash Hounds now hunt only targets below 35% HP.

groups.heading: New
items: Region III enemies reworked: familiar foes return alongside Halberdiers, Ash Hounds and stronger veterans.
Thornwood Hollow has a new elite, the Drake Priest.
Lord Morvane is a true final boss with three phases, Ashfall and the Pyre of Morvane.
Every Region III battle has a different line-up, with new enemy sounds.

groups.heading: Changes
items: New Region III enemies borrow older art for now; their own art is coming next.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Elite enemies no longer freeze in their attack pose after an area skill.
Rest, Skip, Move and the combat log stay in place no matter how many skills a fighter has.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Settings are split into pages: Sound, Gameplay, Display and Privacy.
Patch notes open instantly and show five versions per page.
The loading screen shows its background right away.
The error report notice is smaller on phones, has a Turkish version and fuller privacy details.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The privacy info window no longer opens behind Settings.

groups.heading: New
items: Optional error reports: turn them on in Settings > Privacy to help us fix crashes. Off by default, anonymous, kept 30 days.
Settings > Privacy > Copy log copies recent game events so you can share them by hand.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Battles use much less memory on phones; Grave Field no longer drops you to the main menu.
If the phone resets the graphics, the game shows a short note and recovers.
Grey Wolves are smaller and no longer cover each other.
A Warrior holding a one-handed axe or mace no longer hides his face.
The fighter info card now scrolls on phones.

groups.heading: New
items: Region II enemies now have their own art, skill icons, skill animations and sounds.
The tutorial region has new enemies: Cutpurse, Grey Wolves, Ravenwood Poacher, Raven Seer and the Bandit Chief.
The High Priest and the Bandit Chief change pose when they attack, cast, get hit and fall.
Tap any fighter in battle: the card now lists their skills; tap a skill to read it.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Merchant: double-tap an item in your bag to sell it (you can buy it back).
Ravenwood: after a new hero joins you can arrange your formation before the battle.
Equipping with a double-tap plays a short click; double-tap equips on phones too.

groups.heading: New
items: Region II gets new foes: Deep Runecaller, Grave Chanter, Oathsworn Brother, Censer Monk and the High Priest of the Undying.
Every enemy in Region II now has its own skills and a unique passive; read them in the Codex under Enemy passives.
Pilgrim Road: a rival adventuring company, The Silver Stag Company, blocks the way.
Witch's Hut: stealing from Morwen now starts a duel with the hedge witch herself.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Region II battles have new line-ups; nearly every fight has a spellcaster.
Some new enemies still borrow other art; their own art arrives in a later update.

groups.heading: New
items: Version 0.8: the campaign tutorial with Garrick, your mentor, and many new lessons.
Campaign: Retreat to Map pauses the battle; return to the same stop to resume it.
Merchant: buy back what you sold during this visit, on phones too.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: you start as a Warrior or an Archer; all classes open up in Ashford.
Campaign balance: a smoother climb after the tutorial and easier regions after Ashford.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: Windy Moor, Iron Pass and Charcoal Camp are easier.
The in-game Menu is slightly see-through.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Phones: heroes and enemies no longer turn invisible after several battles.
Equip best and dragging no longer put a dagger in the off-hand while the main hand is empty.
Campaign map: fog no longer covers the stops you can travel to.
Phones: with Valor in battle, the Combat log button stays on screen.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: every enemy after Ashford is 5% weaker in health and damage.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Ruined Watchtower: the Bandit Chief has slightly less health and hits a little softer.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Merchant on phones: a Buy back tab lets you buy back what you sold during this visit.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: your first hero is a Warrior or an Archer; all classes open up when you form your company in Ashford.
Ravenwood: the companion offered depends on your first hero.
Tutorial battles are a little tougher.

groups.heading: New
items: Garrick teaches more: hit chance, reading a fighter, helping allies, fallen heroes, wounds, the road, rest camps and item quality.
First battle: a second guided turn shows your stronger MP skill, and the screen dims around what the mentor points at.
Settings > Gameplay: Replay tutorials plays every lesson again.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: the first battles after Ashford are easier, so the step up from the tutorial is smoother.
Campaign: Ravenwood and the Ruined Watchtower are a little tougher again; later regular fights are slightly harder.

groups.heading: New
items: Garrick, your tutorial mentor, has his own portrait.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: Retreat to Map now pauses the battle. Return to that stop to resume from the same turn; the road and gear stay locked until then.
Campaign: enemies after Ashford are slightly tougher.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: First battle: buttons the mentor is not asking for are greyed out, and the mentor's box shakes if you press one.
Merchant: tapping outside the welcome card opens the shop.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Endless: the Revive reward card is gone; fallen heroes return with Valor, Resurrection or Raise Dead. Enemies grow a bit slower per wave.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Endless: Retreat to Camp no longer restarts the wave; the battle stays paused and resumes where you left it.

groups.heading: New
items: Tutorial lessons now appear only when they matter, and point at the button to use right then.
Hits feel different by strength: light flinch, normal hit, or a heavy knockback with dust.
New painted Valor braziers, shown small at the top left next to Back.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Back, Menu and fullscreen are matching icon buttons in one row; fullscreen is available on every screen size.
Smaller tutorial box on phones; the first battles are easier.
Merchant and Gear screens fit phones: no overlap, full stat names, whole bag rows.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Arriving at Ashford no longer freezes the game; stuck saves continue normally.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The loading screen now turns sideways with the game when a phone is held upright.

groups.heading: New
items: New logo, app icon and loading screen.
Campaign tutorial: Commander Garrick teaches one thing at a time; turn it off in Settings or with Don't show again.
Codex Lessons: reread every tutorial lesson you have seen. Endless shows a short intro the first time.
Music for the map, town, battles, bosses and the Endless camp, plus parchment, book, coin, gear and battle horn sounds.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Heroes stand in a narrower stance, keep each item in the same hand and hold edged weapons point up.
Hands come down right after a skill lands instead of hanging in the air.
Fewer hint texts on screens; the Back button no longer shows an Esc tag.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: You can enter Ashford again after leaving it.

groups.heading: New
items: Valor: wins light embers in two braziers; spend them to revive a fallen hero, in battle or between battles.
Heroes now fight with full animated poses and show the weapon they wield.
New moves: Cutthroat crosses both daggers for Saltire Cut; the Hexer pins her doll for Doom Mark; Archer aims high for Arrow Rain.
The three new shields have their own icons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign enemies hit harder to match Valor.
Endless: two foes every wave; each boss is tougher than the last.
Fire Bolt, Nature's Wrath and Void Strike cost 1 more MP.
Card Trick's cards are smaller.

groups.heading: New
items: New battle backgrounds for every campaign region, King's Bridge and the Castle Hall; new town art.
Campaign enemies have their own looks: thugs, crossbowmen, ember acolytes, fen witchlings, ghouls, shieldwardens, wisps and more.
Three new shields; Settings now has a separate Sound Effects volume.
Map: click a stop to march there; battles ask before they start; hover a stop to see who waits there.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Each gear slot now has its own kind of stats (weapons hit, armor protects, boots move, trinkets sustain).
Stats that reach their limit are marked MAX; only two copies of the same top-tier affix count.
Hexer: Doom takes 4 turns; skills hit harder and Doom a little softer; Doom Mark deals 10% more. Omens no longer jump on from a Doom kill.
Party picking uses the same drag-and-drop everywhere; the Codex no longer lists test characters.

groups.heading: New
items: Campaign battles now have their own backgrounds for every region of Valdoria.
Towns open as a full scene: visit the stall, the notice board, the locals and the campfire.
Menus are centered with icons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Debug: Pose Tester skills now use fitting poses; spells and arrows leave from the weapon.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: New campaign setup no longer replays its animation on every click.

groups.heading: New
items: Debug: 11 Pose Testers try every class's skills with the new poses and weapons.
New weapon art: maces, daggers, staves, bows, shields, charms, great axes and mauls.

groups.heading: Changes
items: A two-handed weapon shows a faded copy in the Off-hand slot.
Warrior's Rage now sits in line with HP and MP.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Statuses like Omen now appear when the skill lands, not when it is cast.

groups.heading: New
items: New Off-hand slot: carry a shield or a second dagger next to a one-handed weapon.
Weapons now show whether they are one-handed, two-handed, a bow or a charm.
Valdren Keep: convince the commander and he shares how to beat the Bridge Warden.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Witch's Hut deals now give one item and a little gold.
Windy Moor, Iron Pass and Charcoal Camp fight a little harder; Hard is tougher.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Gifts show as a Gift on the spoils card.

groups.heading: New
items: Campaign: new enemy families (bandits, Ember Cult, guardians, hexes, undead) on the roads from Windy Moor to Misty Marsh.
Witch's Hut and Shepherd's Fold now offer choices.
Towns have a merchant and a short story scene; talk to the charcoal burner in Ashford.
Codex: a new Enemies section.
Version 0.7: everything from 0.6.10 to 0.6.14.1 in one release.
Campaign: new Valdoria map, Rest camps, merchants, fallen heroes and a full rebalance.
Items: affix tiers, rare drops, 18 Legendary items with their own icons.
Touch: one tap opens an item; Gear and the campaign map are cleaner.
Campaign: elite fights are a little easier, bosses a little harder.

groups.heading: New
items: Campaign: fallen heroes stay down after battle; revive them at Rest camps or in town.
Towns now fully heal and revive your whole company for free.
Shepherd's Fold offers a rest after its event.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign rebalanced: regular and elite enemies are weaker, heroes heal 25% after each win.
Legendary items now roll at the level of the place they drop.
Campaign map: tap a road to see it, tap again to march; road info sits under your party.
Gear slots show only the item name; touch: one tap opens an item, with Equip, Buy or Sell buttons.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Old character art removed from the game files and the Codex.
All 18 Legendary items now have their own hand-painted icons.
Codex updated: a new Endless article, item affixes and rarity rolls, rare drops, battle speed and the new bar regen display.
Codex status pages now show which Legendary items apply Burning and Fleet.

groups.heading: New
items: Valdoria's map is redrawn and longer, with a Rest camp and a merchant stop on the road.
Rest camps heal your company for free; fallen heroes can be revived there for gold.
Zoom the campaign map with the mouse wheel or a pinch.
Debug: Pose Tester I and II try other classes' skills with the new poses.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The Gear skill bar now matches the battle skill bar.
Merchant: Wares and Character are tabs; Odo shows all stats of today's pick.
Old campaign saves must restart because the map changed.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Combat log no longer mixes the next turn's healing or damage into the previous action.

groups.heading: New
items: The Warrior now moves through real poses: slashes, a spinning Whirlwind, a war cry.
The Warrior's weapon shows the sword or axe he has equipped.
Lucky Escape plays its own moment: the blow glances off and a lucky horseshoe flips.
Debug: a pose tester to try every Warrior pose and weapon.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Turn-start healing and mana no longer float over heads; the bars glow instead.
Battle numbers no longer overlap each other.
The in-game menu is a bit larger; the main menu music fades in gently.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Fighters no longer float above the floor in the castle hall; battles use less memory.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Codex asset pages open about twice as fast.
Returning to the main menu no longer stutters while the music restarts.
Less background work on every screen, for smoother play on phones.

groups.heading: New
items: Gear is split into a Character page and an Inventory page; the bag is the same everywhere.
Item tooltips follow the cursor, and hero cards show what an item would change for them.
Equip by dragging or double-clicking; drag to the trash to discard.
Odo welcomes you, and the reward screen has a View bag button.
Tap the version number to read these patch notes.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Rarer items roll stronger bonuses; Endless items keep growing with the wave.
Settings section titles are easier to tell apart.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Mana Steal no longer drains mana when the attack misses, is dodged or is saved by Lucky Escape.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Items reworked: rarity now means more bonus stats, and item power grows with item level.
Eight new Legendary items.
One shared loot table for campaign rewards, Endless rewards and the merchant.
Your saves are updated to the new item system automatically.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Status badges on phones no longer overlap: the most important ones come first, the rest show as +N.
Clearer rarity frames on merchant cards.
Smoother fade when leaving the in-game Menu.

groups.heading: New
items: Performance mode in Settings (Auto, On, Off) for slower phones.
Show FPS option in Settings.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Battles run much smoother, especially on phones.
Switching between skills reacts faster.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Settings now has a Sounds section: Master Volume, Music and UI sounds.
Every slider has 20 steps: volumes from 0 to 100%, battle speed from 0.25x to 4x.
The menu music starts right after your first click or tap.
Endless: enemies grow stronger a little more slowly each wave.

groups.heading: New
items: Main menu music: a medieval tune with lute, flute, drone and frame drum.
The game version is shown in the main menu corner. Tap it to read these notes.
Battle speed setting: shorter or longer pauses between turns.
Gear shows your hero's skills, and how each item changes their numbers.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Endless: the battlefield stays between waves, and fallen heroes can be revived with a reward card.
Speed bars fill up between turns so you can see who acts next.
Stat tips in Gear and at the merchant show what goes up (green) and down (red).

groups.heading: New
items: Legendary items: one unique item per hero, with rare drops after victories.
Painted art for every item, status and map icon.
Endless: pick and arrange your company with drag and drop.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The same debuff no longer stacks: casting it again refreshes it.
Endless: open your bag from the reward screen; items are no longer sold automatically.
Medieval sounds for menus and buttons, with their own volume.
The game loads faster.

groups.heading: New
items: Animated main menu: a burning Valdoria at dusk, with smoke, embers and crows.
Reduced motion setting for a calmer menu.
New battle look with a slimmer bar, and the merchant Odo the Peddler in Endless.
New art for the Campaign, Quick Battle and Multiplayer cards, and new Defender effects.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Multiplayer: Rematch no longer blocks the other buttons and can be cancelled.
